title: netwatch Tier-2 -> Tier-1 verdict (the 'result' text of claude's JSON envelope)

key.description: must echo a key from the packet

proposed_whitelist_entry.description: proposal only; Tier 1 writes it to proposals.jsonl, never applies it. Deliberately permissive HERE: the launcher separately validates every proposal against whitelist.schema.json and drops invalid ones without failing the verdict.

$comment: Enforced by invoke-tier2.ps1 via Test-Json (2026-08-28, reviewer M1: the previous cross-file $ref made the schema unparseable and it was never applied). Unknown EXTRA fields are tolerated on purpose - a paid retry costs more than ignoring a harmless field; unknown KEYS and key-set mismatches are still rejected by Test-VerdictShape, which additionally enforces: verdict==ALARM if any assessment==suspicious; every packet key answered.
